dedupe_keys.name: irap road star ratings and safety insights explorer

description: The International Road Assessment Programme (iRAP), a global charity, provides methods and tools for measuring and managing road infrastructure safety, and publishes aggregate results through its Safety Insights Explorer. Road attribute surveys are processed in iRAP's online platform ViDA into Star Ratings of roads for each road user, fatal and serious injury estimates and investment plans; the Safety Insights Explorer shows estimated injuries by country, age and sex, Star Ratings and key design attributes for more than 500,000 km of roads in 84 countries, and the business case for investing in 3-star or better roads. iRAP reports over 4.6 million km of road assessed worldwide, and national programmes run under free licence agreements with local partners; the methodology and specification manuals are in its library. Coverage is global, with assessed roads in 84 countries in the explorer. Access: the explorer and manuals are free on the iRAP website, and ViDA is described as free-to-air, while detailed survey data belong to each programme's partners. Caveats: coverage depends on which roads partners have surveyed, and the web pages read do not give a data licence. It supports road safety risk mapping, prioritisation of safety investment and vulnerability of road users, and complements the SafetyCube decision support system catalogued here.
